aiSettings.title: AI Configuration
aiSettings.inspectionDesc: When enabled, after fast and full scans complete, inspection tasks call the LLM for a second-pass review of detected anomalies; conclusions are written to the ai_summary field of inspection results. At least one config in the LLM config list below must be enabled. Disabled by default and does not affect the existing inspection flow.
aiSettings.adaptiveBaselineDesc: Switch alert rules from fixed thresholds to dynamic baseline detection (z-score outlier detection) with mutation detection. Only applies to latency and packet loss rules; alerts are not triggered when fewer than 10 historical samples exist. All rules default to static thresholds.
aiSettings.latencyPacketLossOnly: Only latency and packet loss rules are supported
aiSettings.mutationThresholdTip: Change rate relative to baseline; 0.5 means 50% change
aiSettings.apiUrlTip: Only https URLs are allowed; internal or localhost addresses are rejected (existing configs unaffected; validated on edit/save)
